content.Title: Applying the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Class of Recommendation and Level of Evidence to Clinical Strategies, Interventions, Treatments, or Diagnostic Testing in Patient Care

Level A.Description: High-quality evidence from more than 1 RCT

Level B-R.Description: Moderate-quality evidence from 1 or more RCTs

Level B-NR.Description: Moderate-quality evidence from well-designed nonrandomized studies

Level C-LD.Description: Randomized or nonrandomized observational or registry studies with limitations

Level C-EO.Description: Consensus of expert opinion based on clinical experience

Other Information.Importance of Clinical Questions: Many important clinical questions addressed in guidelines do not lend themselves to clinical trials.
